title: rosa × polliniana var. acutifolia
intro: Rosa × polliniana var. acutifolia, commonly known as the Pink Rose or Chinese Rose, is a type of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality due to its sedative and anxiolytic properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × polliniana var. acutifolia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as geraniol and linalool, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
